verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs state a clear captcha stance: 'Auto-CAPTCHA solvers' that bypass challenges automatically for uninterrupted execution. A community comment confirms this is a marketed feature but does not confirm it works. The live view lets a human take over the browser, but it is never documented as a captcha fallback, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: a dedicated captcha docs page describing supported captcha types, behavior and error reporting when solving fails (to rule out silent failures), a documented human-fallback flow for captchas, and independent or hands-on corroboration that solving works.
